parole.significato: A member of a people native to the Northwest Territories of Canada.
parole.testo: From dog + rib, a calque of Dogrib Tłı̨chǫ (“dog-flank”), from tłı̨ (“dog”) + echǫǫ̀ (“rib area, flank”), the dog-flank people, from a traditional legend.

parole.significato: A Native American people living in the Northwest Territories of Canada.
